chunks: And by this chain, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام) concerning His, the Exalted, saying:
“And give glad tidings to those who believe that they have a true footing with their Lord.”
He said: “It is the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام).”

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amīr al-Muʾminīn; the title of Imam ʿAlī (عليه السلام)
key_terms.الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا: those who believe; the faithful addressed in the verse
key_terms.بَشِّرِ: give glad tidings; a divine command to announce good news
key_terms.عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ: with their Lord; indicating nearness and honored standing before Allah
key_terms.قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ: a true footing; a truthful and firmly established station with Allah
key_terms.وَلَايَةُ: wilayah; divinely appointed authority and allegiance

ai.seo_question: What does “قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ” mean in Shia hadith interpretation?
ai.summary: This report interprets the Quranic phrase “a true footing with their Lord” as the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī (عليه السلام). It presents the verse as indicating the exalted standing and saving significance of belief joined with rightful allegiance.
